description.en: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

description.zh:
设备的**DeviceName**。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
description.en:
The **DeviceName** of the device.  
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

description.zh:
设备ID，该参数可以通过调用[QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~)获取。

>如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
description.en:
The Device ID. You can obtain this parameter by calling [QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~).  
> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a unique identifier for the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the **ProductKey**/**DeviceName** combination, **IotId** takes precedence.

description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.  
></notice>  

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh: 设备所属的产品**ProductKey**。如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
description.en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.

description.zh:
下发给设备的唯一播报ID。
><notice>
若不传入则由系统生成，若业务上进行重试播报，需传入重试的播报ID，避免出现重复业务播报。
></notice>
description.en:
A unique playback ID assigned to the device.  
><notice>  
If this parameter is not provided, the system generates one automatically. If your business logic requires a retry of the playback, you must provide the same playback ID used in the original request to avoid duplicate playback.  
></notice>
The playback speed. Valid values range from -500 to 500.

description.zh: 语料文本，当语料类型选择为自定义语料时，该参数必选。语料文本支持英文字母、汉字和空格，长度为1~100个字符，一个汉字占两个字符。
description.en: The speech text. This parameter is required if you select custom speech material. The text can contain English letters, Chinese characters, and spaces. The length must be 1 to 100 characters, where each Chinese character counts as two characters.

description.zh: 语料播报声音，由系统预设，例如标准女声、标准男声等。可以选择的声音类型通过[GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~)进行查询，填入返回参数中`VoiceList`中`Value`的值。
description.en: The voice used for corpus playback is preset by the system, such as Standard Female or Standard Male. You can query the available voice types by calling [GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~) and use the `Value` field from the `VoiceList` in the response.
The volume level. Valid values: 0 to 100.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API is 10 per Alibaba Cloud account.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot speech-by-synthesis --voice Siyue --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --speech-rate 0 --text test --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name test --speech-id 4200001139202111238000000000 --audio-format wav --volume 50 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot SpeechBySynthesis --region cn-hangzhou --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --Volume 50 --Text test --AudioFormat wav --Voice Siyue --SpeechRate 0 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName test --SpeechId 4200001139202111238000000000
